understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each level’s grid to reach and complete all goal cells. A goal only completes when the carried piece matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the same time, and you step onto the goal tile. Completing every goal in a level advances to the next level; finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (N/S/E/W) costs 1 stamina. When stamina hits 0, you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max; losing all lives ends the game (GAME_OVER). Movement is constrained by walls, represented via a per-turn blocked_directions list; attempting a blocked direction wastes a turn/stamina and provides no benefit, so you must always choose an unblocked direction and route around obstacles. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape modifiers cycle shape IDs 0–5 (wrapping), color modifiers cycle colors in order orange → blue → green → red → orange, and rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise through 0° → 90° → 180° → 270° → 0°. A goal activates only when shape, color, and rotation all match simultaneously; stepping onto an activated goal completes it. Some tiles can refill stamina.
